reliability.fleissKappaDescription: Fleiss' Kappa measures agreement among multiple raters across multiple cases. Requires 3+ raters who completed all cases.
reliability.agreementNote: Agreement percentage shows how often raters selected the same classification for each case. Cases with low agreement (< 60%) are highlighted.

analytics.distributionDescription: How respondents classified this case across different systems

reliability.title: Inter-Rater Reliability
reliability.detailedDescription: Confusion matrix and category distribution per classification system
reliability.weightedKappaDescription: Weighted Kappa accounts for the severity of disagreements in ordinal classifications. Adjacent category disagreements are penalized less than distant ones.
reliability.diagnosticMetricsDescription: Sensitivity, specificity, and predictive values show how well raters identify each classification category compared to the gold standard.
reliability.diagnosticMetricsNote: Values closer to 100% indicate better diagnostic performance. F1 Score is the harmonic mean of sensitivity and PPV, providing a balanced measure of accuracy.
reliability.sensitivityDescription: True positive rate: proportion of actual positives correctly identified (TP / (TP + FN))
reliability.specificityDescription: True negative rate: proportion of actual negatives correctly identified (TN / (TN + FP))
reliability.ppvDescription: Positive Predictive Value: proportion of positive predictions that are correct (TP / (TP + FP))
reliability.npvDescription: Negative Predictive Value: proportion of negative predictions that are correct (TN / (TN + FN))
reliability.f1ScoreDescription: Harmonic mean of sensitivity and PPV, providing a balanced measure of accuracy (2 × PPV × Sensitivity / (PPV + Sensitivity))
reliability.noDataForSystem: No data available for this classification system
reliability.fleissKappaNote: Fleiss' Kappa requires multiple cases (subjects) to calculate inter-rater reliability. Current case design has a single case. Consider creating a study with multiple cases for proper reliability assessment.

divergence.pathAnalysisDesc: User decision paths compared to the gold standard
divergence.backClickTooltip: Analyzes correlation between using the back button and final answer correctness. Positive = more back clicks correlates with correct answers. Negative = more back clicks correlates with incorrect answers.
divergence.correlationPositiveDesc: Users who use the back button more tend to get the correct answer, suggesting reviewing helps.
divergence.correlationNegativeDesc: Users who use the back button more tend to get incorrect answers, suggesting confusion.
divergence.correlationNoneDesc: No clear relationship between back button usage and correctness.
